description.value: Browns Socialhouse Tofino is a casual full-service chain restaurant located within the Best Western Tin Wis Resort on the Pacific Rim Highway, serving regional and American cuisine. Part of the Browns Restaurant Group with dozens of locations across BC and Alberta, the Tofino outpost sits on the main highway corridor into town, making it a natural stop for cyclists arriving or departing the area. The restaurant acknowledges it rests on the ancestral and traditional lands of the Tla-o-qui-aht First Nation.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the Tofino location at 1119 Pacific Rim Hwy within the Best Western Tin Wis Resort, matching OSM address and phone number. The site navigation prominently features 'Order Delivery & Pickup', confirming takeout is available. No website content addresses bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any other cyclist-specific amenities, so those are left null.
concerns: OSM addr:street tag abbreviates 'Pacific Rim Hwy' as 'Pacific Rm Hwy'; website uses the full 'Pacific Rim Hwy'.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible chain restaurant on the main highway into Tofino — a useful food and drink stop for touring cyclists regardless of confirmed cyclist-specific amenities.

wow_evidence: Browns Restaurant Group with dozens of locations across BC and Alberta
